crumb: What a Clear Title Looks Like for Property in Tamil Nadu
title: What a Clear Title Looks Like for Property in Tamil Nadu
description: A clear title means ownership can be traced and nobody else has a claim. The signs of a clean title, the red flags that need a lawyer, and a free check.
h1: What a clear title looks like, and the red flags that need a lawyer
lead: Sellers say the title is clear. A buyer should be able to see why.
wa: Hi, I read your guide and have a question about my property in Pondicherry

bullets: An unbroken chain of registered deeds from the earliest available owner to the seller
Revenue records in the seller’s name matching the deed
An encumbrance certificate with no unexplained mortgage or claim
All co-owners and heirs accounted for and signing
The seller will not show original documents
Names or spellings differ between documents
A sale by power of attorney with no explanation
A price well below the neighbours
Pressure to pay an advance quickly

paras: Have a lawyer read the chain. Our [document check](/buy-property-pondicherry#document-check) screens the papers first so you do not pay for a legal opinion on a property that fails at step one. See also [documents to check](/guides/documents-to-check-before-buying-plot).

blocks.p: Send the documents. We will tell you plainly what we see.

actions.label: Send documents for a free check
